description: National Police Commission - National Police Commission delegated Some of its Powers to the Inspector General and Police Officers as Specified in the Govt. Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1965/37 dated 05/06/2016 the Schedule is replaced 26.01.2017
categorisation: This gazette content deals with the delegation of powers by the National Police Commission to various police officers (Inspector General of Police, Senior Deputy Inspectors General, etc.) regarding police personnel matters including appointments, promotions, transfers, disciplinary control, and dismissals. This falls under Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes as it specifically concerns law enforcement regulations, procedures, and the administrative authority structure within the police force.
